name: iso-city-builder
prompt: An isometric city-builder in the style of SimCity: zone residential/commercial/industrial land, draw roads, watch buildings grow or abandon as demand shifts, cars routing over whatever network you build

gdd.title: Iso City Builder
gdd.tagline: Zone it, road it, watch it grow
gdd.loop: Paint zones and roads with money you have. Buildings spawn on zoned tiles with road access and grow (or abandon) each tick based on demand. No fail state — a running simulation.

actions.name: Select tool
actions.description: Pan / Road / Residential / Commercial / Industrial / Bulldoze

actions.name: Paint
actions.description: Apply the selected tool to tiles under the cursor

entities.behavior: spawns on zoned+road-accessible tiles, grows/abandons per demand
BFS-routes over the live road network
spawns near buildings as population grows, wanders roads

world.start: mostly empty grid with a seed plus-shaped avenue and one starter house

gdd.assetPipeline: reuses examples/pixel-city sprites — same asset economy per skills/iso-city-builder/SKILL.md
